latest_release.name: v3.10.3
latest_release.body:
## Added

- **Personal AI preferences**: a settings entry in the AI panel stores your conversation display level (Compact / Standard / Detailed) and whether the AI may include command snippets. Preferences apply to your account only and sync across devices; the display level takes effect immediately, the command-snippet switch from the next request.

## Fixed

- AI file tools were wrongly reported as "file system disabled" because an asset protocol was missing.
- Credential rotation: sudo compatibility, shared-reference validation, and failure recovery, with the generated license configuration updated accordingly.

## Changed

- AI conversation view: execution steps collapse or expand according to your preference, with new running states (running, waiting for approval, completed, stopped, failed) and an "N tool calls" summary; tool cards now show the tool name, arguments, explanation, and file content.
- Asset access and groups: the asset access button and action bar share one style, and deleting a host or website asset group now asks for confirmation.

---

## 新增

- **个人 AI 偏好**：AI 面板新增设置入口，可保存「对话展示级别」（简洁 / 标准 / 详细）与「AI 携带命令片段」开关。偏好仅对当前账号生效、跨设备同步；展示级别保存后立即生效，命令片段开关从下一次请求开始生效。

## 修复

- AI 文件工具因遗漏资产协议被误判为「文件系统未启用」的问题。
- 凭据轮换：sudo 场景兼容性、共享引用校验与失败恢复，并同步更新授权配置文件生成。

## 调整

- AI 对话展示：执行过程按偏好折叠或展开，新增运行状态（正在执行 / 等待确认 / 执行完成 / 执行已停止 / 执行失败）与「N 次工具调用」摘要；工具卡片补齐工具名称、参数、操作说明与文件内容展示。
- 资产接入与分组：统一资产接入按钮与操作栏样式；删除主机／网站资产分组时增加二次确认。

> This repo is frontend-only. Docs: https://www.next-terminal.com/docs/ · 中文文档: https://www.next-terminal.com/zh/docs/ · Demo: https://demo.next-terminal.com
> Security: support@next-terminal.com
